correctness.rationale: For \(k\ge2\) and \(L_i\ge3\), induction proves the complete firing orbit: the hub count is \(2k-1-|\{i:L_i\le t\}|\) at times \(1\le t\le m\), and on each petal with \(t<L_i\) there is exactly one nonfiring peripheral vertex \(v_{i,t}\). The configuration returns at exactly \(m=\max_iL_i\). The \(m\) firing simplices form a good cover whose nerve contains every proper face of a simplex but no top face, hence their union has integral homotopy type \(S^{m-2}\). Each earlier prefix is a cone; one additional hub chip makes the first firing set full. The standalone independent simulation checks 3900 ordered length tuples and mod-two homology in six representative cases. Universality and integrality follow from the proof, not the finite checks.

value.rationale: A complete natural infinite branching graph family with near-critical chips (one below the number of arcs) has a precise longest-petal homotopy type and single persistent birth. The dimension and onset remain invariant under arbitrary additions of shorter petals; adding one chip at the branch vertex removes all reduced homology. The result directly answers a new graph-class instance of the 2026 foundational paper’s explicit extension direction and gives an interpretable dynamical and topological boundary, beyond standard cycle calculations.
